notes.subject: ijdeɣyifen
notes.rationale: הפרח d akalad 'taẓawt/iǧdeɣif' — deg umkan-agi d taẓawt n ṛṛedlaɣ deg umerg, mačči d tamedlaṛt.

notes.subject: temṣuḍaf
notes.rationale: המלקחים — tiselḍabin (tweezers), d aneggal; talɣa n twinest deg teɛbranit tettwakkes.

notes.subject: מכלות זהב
notes.rationale: KJV 'perfect gold' vs YLT 'perfection of gold' — מכלות yezmer ad yili 'azref n ṛṛedlaɣ' neɣ 'ṛṛedlaɣ iffus akk'; nerna 'meṛṛa' am akken yella deg YLT.

notes.subject: ṛṛedlaɣ iffus
notes.rationale: Deg-wes-agi n tfelwit d taktayt n wazal: akk isuka yennum-ilin ṛṛedlaɣ iffus.

translation: d yijdeɣyifen, d yiserseɛ, d temṣuḍaf — ṛṛedlaɣ d-nni, d-nni meṛṛa ṛṛedlaɣ.
